text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Many Bosnians hope that peace will be stable and that America will fulfil its obligations as the leading country in the world, Bosnian President Alija Izetbegovic says in congratulation message to President Clinton.

- The British government's aid wing, the Overseas Development Administration (ODA), plans new projects of assistance in Bosnia in 1997, with a priority on rebuilding infrastructure, an ODA minister says in an interview on Wednesday.

- A meeting between Bosnia's collective presidency and the international community representatives scheduled for November 14 in Paris will not bring anything spectacular. "Real things" will happen in London at a December 4 meeting, say Bosnian delegation sources. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
